The Customer

A safe place to practice the pitch before you make it for real.

What it is

The Customer is a sales-practice role-play agent. It plays a realistic K-12 school-district buyer, lets you run a full conversation, and then steps out of character to coach you on how it went. It is a sparring partner, not a script - you talk, it pushes back the way a real prospect would, and you get better with every rep.

Who it plays

  • IT Director - the technical decision-maker who cares about integration, security, and support.
  • Junior Tech - hands-on, lower authority, needs things made simple.
  • Business Manager - budget, ROI, and procurement timing.
  • Front-Office Secretary - the day-to-day user who lives in the product.

What you can practice

  • Cold pitch and opening
  • Discovery questions
  • Objection handling
  • Support calls
  • Renewal conversations

How a session works

  1. Tell it the persona and scenario you want to practice.
  2. Run the conversation - it stays in character and reacts like a real prospect.
  3. When you are done, it drops the role and debriefs you with a GROW coaching structure and a behavior-based scorecard so you know exactly what to work on next.
Two things to remember. It is not a real customer - nothing it says reflects an actual account. And the scorecard is practice feedback, not data - it measures how you handled the rep, not anyone's real buying intent.

Try starting with

"Play an IT Director at a mid-size district. I'm cold-calling about VirtuaTime. Be a little skeptical."

"I want to practice handling the 'we already have a time clock' objection. Go."

"Run a renewal call where the business manager is worried about budget, then coach me."
